Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: So far I'm very impressed with this Grill. I've had several Traeger's over the years, and so far this is the best one hands down.  First, it really holds the temps well.  Previous models have struggled a bit, but this one really holds it well. Second, the construction is very solid and I like the seal around the lid. It will take at least two people to assemble, because it's heavy!  But I like that, and means its very solid.  Third, I really love how there is no smoke chimney.  Instead it's even across the back.  This makes it easier to put cover on, and does a better job of smoking!  There are a few other great features as well so I'm very pleased.  The only reason for not giving 4 stars is the drip pan underneath is a little weird.  Time will tell how functional, in some ways I really like it, other ways i'm not sure yet.  if you buy their foil covers they don't fit right, so I had to add my own foil as well. Which is fine, but just weird.  Also, I'm still struggling getting the Wi-Fi to work.  I'm fairly tech savvy (at least I think I am) but it had the grill as its own Wi-Fi - so getting it connected to the home network hasn't happened yet.  Instructions are very clear and I love that it has a scan code on the inside!  However, so far I don't have it working yet.  So depending on drip pan and Wi-Fi this review could go to full 5 or down to a 3!  But it is a great grill and I do recommend it.
Results.Title: Great Grill!

Results.ReviewText:
So far this has been great! I replaced a Camp-Chef model that I had to seriously babysit from day one, but the Timberline, not so much. I’ve done a few long smoke cycles already and will be doing a 12 hour this weekend for a couple briskets and pork butts. Can’t wait!

My only gripe is the location of the bin sensor and the bin clean out. 

For the sensor, it’s placed directly above the auger drop which gets lower before the rest of the bin and thus you get warnings of low pellets prematurely. Not a huge deal. I just push pellets from one side to the other until it’s actually really low. 

For the bin clean out, it’s placed in the back, which is fine, except that the rear wheel prevents me moving any of my pellet containers under it. My first try to swap pellets was a heck of a mess. So now I’ll be using a small handheld container in one hand and something to push the pellets in the other. And hopefully not make a mess again. :)
Results.Title: Best upgrade ever!

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 850 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: I have had nothing but success using this grill. I enjoy the ease of use, the wifire technology is really takes grilling / smoking to a new level. The double wall construction of this grill is a huge plus in controlling and maintaining temperature. It also keeps the exterior of the grill from becoming overly hot, even when it’s cranked up to 450-500, you can touch the exterior and not burn yourself, impressive and great for when kids are around.  My only knock on the grill is the pellet sensor is not overly reliable, more often than not, there are more pellets in the box than what is being reported.

SuperSmoke feature is great for BBQ, I was a skeptic of how much of a smoke profile this would actually generate with the meat and was put in my place. The reverse sear on steaks with SS is great too, whole new concept for me and well worth the time it takes to prepare. We've always been big on grilling vegetables in our home too and this grill has raised the bar on flavor and texture. Only con is the grease system, it functions poorly in my opinion and keeping it clean is a constant detailed practice for safety and preventing unwanted flavor in your food, room for improvement. Only complaint is I purchased the prior generation less than 3 months before the current updates to the drive and other small features were made, would have waited if I knew on a purchase like this.

Results.ReviewText: I have had the Timberline 850 for about 6 weeks now.  I love it.  It is well built.  The assembly was easy and the packaging even gives you a beer holder.  The instructions even show you how many beers/drinks at different points of the build.  LOL  I have done a pork shoulder, ribs, briskets and a turkey to date.  The first brisket was okay, the last one was perfection.  It gives a beautiful smoke ring.  The WiFi hooked up with no problem.  I love that feature.  Just ignite and tell it to use one of the online recipes and it does the rest or you can control the temp from the phone and see the probe temperature at all times.
Results.Title: Timberline 850

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 1300 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText:
Every thing has generally been good with my Timberline 1300. Im overall very happy. But a few things i want to mention: 
- bamboo cutting board was warped from day one. I have made sure to bring it in when i am not using the grill 
- i am still waiting on one of the items I ordered over a month ago, i have had to make all attempts to see when it will be fulfilled. At no point was i given and idea that it was backordered until i called two weeks in. Also no timetable for fulfillment given

There need to be much better communication when i comes to items sold and what is actually in stock in the warehouse..... im no logistician but im sure that with in a day or two of placing an order your fulfillment center knows if its in stock and can simply send an email if its out of stock and an estimate when it will be back in stock to the customer
Results.Title: Overall experience

Results.OriginalProductName: Timberline 850 Pellet Grill - In Store Only
Results.ReviewText: From unpacking (complete with humorous beverage suggestions and built-in cardboard cup holders to a box that become a Traeger "cabin" for the kids) to grilling our first tri tip (honestly the best meat I've ever had, and I can't take credit), the Traeger experience reflects, thought, care, and passion. Even a small paint-related issue has given us a chance to see how first-class the Traeger Customer Service team is... From the CEO on down, you can tell that Traeger has been successful in creating a product and an experience, even a culture, around a passion for the power great food has to bring people together.
Results.Title: What a great experience!
